newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $23 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Mar 17.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $23 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Mar 17.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $23 billion of three- and six-month bills on March 17 to pay down $1.125 million as $24.132 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued on March 20. The three-month bills mature on June 19 and the six-month bills mature on September 18.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127944N1 and for the six-month bills is 9127942U7.
